exchanges: big demo today im nervous
Nerves usually mean you care. Who's the demo for?
st marys hospital. procurement team plus their it director
Hospitals are big deals. Do you know what they care most about?
security mostly. sofia is coming w me shes our sales engineer
Good, having someone technical in the room helps with security questions.
ya shes great. she made me stop at 3 cafes this morning to find matcha lol she wont drink anything else
That's real dedication. Hopefully she found some before the demo.
she did. ok heading in
Good luck, you're going to do great.
ok that went well i think
That's great! What made it feel good?
their it director asked a ton of questions which is good. also shes named sofia too lol sofia reyes
Lots of questions usually means real interest. Two Sofias must have made the intros fun.
ya lol. she drank like 3 espresso shots during the meeting she was wired
Sounds like she was very alert for your security section at least.
ha ya. ok back at the office
How's the office today?
loud. ezekiel is on his phone in the corner talking about some gig
Sounds like an interesting call. What kind of gig?
his band. he plays drums for them every friday at a bar on dundas lol hes always tired on mondays
A Friday residency is pretty cool. Mondays must be rough, though.
ya. liang wants a debrief at 2
Is Liang your manager?
ya. hes in a good mood tho hes getting a dog this weekend, a corgi
A new puppy would put anyone in a good mood. Does he have a name picked?
not yet he asked the team for ideas
Fun. Food names are always popular for small dogs.
lol ill suggest somthing. ok debrief time
Good luck, sounds like you have good news to share.
debrief good. oh and liangs dog is a beagle not a corgi, i heard wrong earlier
Lovely dogs, very friendly. A bit loud, though.
lol ya hes gonna learn
He'll have a very vocal new roommate.
next step is a call w their cfo mr abernathy next week
The CFO stage usually means they're serious. What do you know about him?
he was really chatty on the intro call, turns out hes from winnipeg like me so we talked about jets hockey for 20 min
A shared hometown is a great rapport builder. That'll help when you get to pricing.
ya hopefully he goes easy on the discount
Having a good relationship won't hurt your chances there.
ok im out for the day
Well done today. Enjoy your evening.
